name: Beckett (Godot MCP)
summary: Zero-sidecar MCP server that runs inside the Godot 4 editor as a GDScript plugin, letting agents inspect, author, run and screenshot a game in GDScript or C#.
description: The MIT Lite edition has 56 reflection-based tools, served over localhost HTTP/JSON-RPC with Host/Origin checks and a per-project token. It validates scripts before writing them, and every edit can be undone. Enabling the plugin writes `.mcp.json`. Godot 4.2+. A paid Full edition ($15 on itch.io) adds autonomous playtesting. Latest release v1.16.0 (2026-10-06).
